title: The Marathas And Their Policy Of Expansion
definition: The Maratha expansion policy refers to the strategic transition from 'Swarajya' (sovereignty over the homeland) to 'Samrajya' (imperial hegemony), characterized by the institutionalization of Chauth and Sardeshmukhi to finance a mobile military state.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the power vacuum post-Aurangzeb, the transition from Mughal decline to British ascendancy, and the socio-political structure of the 18th-century Indian polity.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Marathas And Their Policy Of Expansion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
